quote: To measure model performance, we use Macro-average F1 score. To measure inter-group parity, we use the pairwise difference in F1 scores averaged over all the groups for predictions on a given relation i. We describe the average difference over all relations as Disparity Score (DS)... PPS is the Macro-average difference (equally weighted) of the F1 score subtracted by the model performance gender gap... We evaluate Equality of Opportunity (EoO)...

We asked workers to determine whether or not a given sentence expressed a given relation. If the majority answer was "no", then we labeled that sentence as expressing "no relation" (we denote them as NA). Each sentence was annotated by three workers.
guideline: Determine whether the sentence expresses the given relation (binary yes/no).
